article.title: Picking an agent's voice by ear, and the car page that handles its own commands

posts.text: Some things a driver says are control, not conversation. On Drive, "repeat that", "stop talking", "louder" and "night mode" are matched on the page before anything reaches a server, while "stop at the next charger" still goes to the agent. The article also covers hearing more than 300 voices in the Voice Lab before you pick one.
